findings.title: `queued` is initialized once at module import
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated when the dataclass is defined, so every `AssignmentSource` created in the same process receives the same timestamp rather than the time that source was created. This makes the `queued` field misleading and prevents it from distinguishing assignment events; use a `default_factory` so each instance gets its own timestamp.
